scope: Corollary 3.5 (The polarity of the reduction) of the manuscript “Variable-dimension Weisfeiler–Leman equivalence on general and subcubic graphs” (preprints/Variable-dimension-Weisfeiler-Leman-equivalence-on-general-and-subcubic-graphs-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 133 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5b3048ce062b1b8e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every binary language L0 ∈ EXPTIME, there are a fixed machine M and fixed integer polynomial p, with p(m) ≥ m + 2, such that a word w of length m can be transformed into a product scalar-image instance at r = 2(p(m) + 2) ≥ 8 that is consistent exactly when w ∈ L0. It has OM ((r + 1)2 + m) real types and comparison schemas, with dimensions in {1, 2}, and is generated in deterministic polynomial time in m.
